title: meshIRCd as a MIMI gateway (server-side provider)
description: Mark 2026-11-21: bead only for now. meshIRCd (Go, federated, S2S JSON-LD over mTLS) could speak MIMI protocol-07 as a provider, its users appearing in MIMI rooms; E2EE ends at the gateway. Depends on the multi-user host design (mimid-kiy1 puppet mode) and on whether meshIRCd continues. Revisit after the IRC bridge (relay mode).
